desks.Dividends: One routine ex-date in the next four weeks: Nvidia, Dec 2, $0.25 per quarter at the unchanged rate, payable Dec 23 — a re-declaration, not a raise. Microsoft went ex Nov 19 at the raised $0.98, its 24th consecutive annual increase, first payment Dec 10. SPY's December distribution is expected about Dec 18, not yet declared. Tesla pays no dividend.
desks.Earnings: No watchlist name reports earnings in the next two weeks; next reports are late January (Apple Jan 28, Microsoft Jan 27, Tesla Jan 27, all estimates). Nvidia reported Tue Nov 17 after the close and has since fallen 19.26% in three sessions to $125.53, with Friday's -14.01% on a Reuters-reported SEC accounting probe that is not SEC-confirmed. The 10-Q is still not filed, so cash-flow quality is UNVERIFIED.
desks.Futures: Brent -5% and Dec WTI -6.5 to -8% on the week — a third straight weekly decline — despite a fourth tanker strike near the Strait of Hormuz and a second Houthi missile hit on Riyadh. The Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral pledged more refined-product supply with no volumes or timetable. Gold fell 8.9% on the week to about $3,552, its worst week in 8 months. USDA Cattle on Feed: October placements 1.891M head, -7.3% year over year, the lowest October on record. Next EIA weekly is Wed Nov 25.
desks.Parity: No parity violation was found on the watchlist. A Nov 12 SPX box-spread scan puts box-implied financing at 3.86% at 15 days rising to 5.16% at 435 days — near the Treasury-bill rate at the short end and about SOFR + 120bp at the long end — parity holding, with any edge vs retail margin erased by execution costs. S&P style-index changes take effect Dec 21, pro-forma files Dec 4.
desks.Premium: A broad down day at the close — SPY 689.81 (-3.64%), QQQ 608.45 (-5.67%), NVDA 125.53 (-14.01%) — and no premium edge is demonstrable. Dec 18 at-the-money IV sits above jump-inflated realized vol on all six names after a 6-25pp one-day jump, and every IV-versus-realized verdict is WINDOW-CONTINGENT: the Nov 5 crash day still drives 35-50% of each 20-day realized-variance window. IV rank is UNVERIFIED for all six names. No watchlist earnings within 45 days.

The top item is #312 (Grasselli et al, joint SPX/VIX/VXX framework, score 59, WATCH): a single specification calibrating equity variance and rolling vol exposure jointly, source-reported and UNVERIFIED. headline: Daily research brief — Friday, November 20

items.detail: Friday's move came on 609.5M shares, about 1.8x recent sessions. Reuters reported that the SEC enforcement division has opened an investigation into Nvidia's accounting, focused on its Singapore revenue reclassification — Reuters-reported, NOT SEC-confirmed; no SEC statement or filing has been seen. The Q3 print itself was a clean beat-and-raise: revenue $115.8B (+103% y/y), EPS $2.68 vs $2.47 consensus, $130B Q4 guide. The 10-Q is still not filed, so the cash-flow quality check stays UNVERIFIED and is now more urgent. Do not cite the Nov 17 -2.89% as the earnings move — the catalyst arrived three sessions after the print.
items.title: Nvidia collapsed 14.01% to $125.53 — three-session post-print drift now -19.26%

items.detail: Michigan final cooled hard: year-ahead expectations 3.7% (prelim 4.3%, Oct 4.7%) — still fires the HIKE trigger (>3.5%), margin now only 20bp. Kalshi repriced toward hold and away from the tail in one session: 25bp $0.92 to $0.90, more than 25bp $0.07 to $0.02, hold $0.04 to $0.11; total hike $0.99 to $0.92. Treasury Secretary Bessent pushed back on a 50bp hike (CNBC, Nov 20) — the first senior administration voice against the tail; he is not an FOMC voter. High-yield spreads widened a fifth straight session to 3.52%, still NEUTRAL, 48bp from the 4.00% watch level.
